item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is full — movement, quiet time, check-ins — and eating can slip to the edges when the schedule gets busy. Don't let dinner become an afterthought squeezed between tasks. Eat on purpose: sit down, slow down, actually taste it. One action: before your evening meal, take three breaths first so you're eating from calm, not autopilot.
